prompt: Photograph the view from the driver's seat of a UK ambulance stopped at a junction on a pouring wet night, low and wide, the steering wheel and the driver's gripping hands dark at the bottom of the frame, a glowing dash screen without text. Filling the windscreen, inches from the bumper: the long black flank of a chauffeured saloon gliding slowly across, its paint beaded with rain, the headlight beams blasting white across its doors. A wiper blade frozen halfway, half the glass clear, half smeared. Through the saloon's rear side window, a suited man in his fifties on the phone, mouth open mid-complaint, eyes down. A police motorcycle shape at the far edge. Sodium-orange streetlamps blooming in the fog. Vertical 9:16, 24mm, 35mm film grain, underexposed, gritty. Thanks.
